3D mobile games

A 3D game for iOS and Android taken from idea to a soft launch in test markets, with ads, purchases and analytics in place before you spend on marketing. An MVP in 12–20 weeks, from UZS 360 mln; the full version in 28–52 weeks.

Estimate it for your business

Timeline and price

Timeline
MVP 12–20 weeksFull 28–52 weeks
Price
MVP UZS 360–845 mln $30,000–70,000Full UZS 960–3,005 mln $80,000–250,000Rate: Central Bank of Uzbekistan, 21.10.2026, $1 = UZS 12,012

Who it is for
Startups, Brands and FMCG, Entertainment venues, Education centres and schools

What you get

What the MVP includes
  • Game design document
  • Unity prototype
  • One polished level or core loop (vertical slice)
  • Basic monetisation
  • Analytics
  • Soft launch in test markets
What the full version adds
  • Launch content (levels, characters, progression)
  • Live-ops tools
  • Ad mediation and in-app purchases
  • Leaderboards
  • Localisation
  • Performance on low-end Android phones
  • Store launch and first updates
Please note

Art style drives cost more than code. The ranges assume stylised 3D, not photorealism.

What we need from you

  • Who plays and why
  • Brand materials
  • One person who makes the decisions

Questions

What does “3D mobile games” cost?
The MVP costs $30,000–70,000 (UZS 360–845 mln), the full version $80,000–250,000 (UZS 960–3,005 mln). The exact price depends on the integrations and the scope.
How long does “3D mobile games” take?
The MVP takes 12–20 weeks, the full version 28–52 weeks.
What do we need to provide?
Who plays and why; Brand materials; One person who makes the decisions.
